column6: Histopathologic study of recurrent herpes simplex labialis lesions

Note: Biopsies taken from lesions at various clinical stages
Vacuolization was the earliest cytoplasmic alteration within keratinocytes
Herpes-induced changes began focally along the basal cell layer
The entire epidermis was rapidly altered
Inclusion bodies were unusual and occurred in late lesions
Both inflammatory cell types were equally prominent
Neutrophils became the predominant inflammatory cells
Histopathologic changes were present before visible physical findings
